it.name: Edjing Mix: DJ Music Mixer App
it.d:
Ready to command the dance floor? edjing Mix puts a professional DJ setup right in your pocket. Mix millions of tracks from your favorite sources, including Spotify, and create killer mashups that will get everyone moving.

Whether you're a bedroom DJ learning the ropes or a music producer looking for a new creative outlet, edjing Mix has you covered. It’s the most powerful virtual turntable experience on the App Store, letting you unleash your creativity anywhere, anytime.

Here's why you'll love it:
• UNLIMITED TRACKS: Connect your Spotify Premium account or mix with millions of songs from Beatport, SoundCloud Go+, your local library, and more.
• INSTANT REMIXING: Fire off over 20 pro-grade DJ FX and samples to electrify your mixes.
• PRO-LEVEL CONTROL: Get hands-on with advanced features like our sampler and hardware integration for a truly tactile feel.

Top Features:
• Seamless Spotify Integration: DJ directly with your Spotify Premium account! Access your playlists, Liked Songs, and full-length tracks across both decks, plus manage your playlists right in the app.
• Automatic BPM Detection: Sync your tracks instantly for flawless beatmatching.
• Stemz: Isolate vocals, drums, or basslines with a single tap to create unique acapellas and instrumentals.
• Studio-Quality FX: Add texture with Echo, Flanger, Reverse, Filter, and other essential audio effects.
• Seamless Looping: From tight 1/64 loops to long 128-beat phrases, you have total creative control.
• HD Recording: Capture your live sets in crystal-clear .wav format to share with the world.

Stop dreaming and start DJing. Download edjing Mix and drop your first beat today!

Note: Spotify integration requires a Spotify Premium subscription. Feature availability may vary by country.

Privacy Policy & Terms of Service: http://edjing.com/public/files/tos/edjing.html

Follow us on:
Website: www.edjing.com
Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/edjingApp
Instagram: http://instagram.com/edjingofficial/
Twitter: http://twitter.com/edjing

Feel free to contact our Team: edjing@mwmapps.com

it.name: Piano ٞ
it.d:
Join over 14 million music lovers discovering piano. Learn the fun and easy way, no lessons needed.
Play songs, practice piano, and create music in one intuitive app.

Choose how you play: follow the rhythm in interactive gameplay to build timing and confidence, or switch to a realistic keyboard to explore chords, melodies, and your own musical ideas.

With Piano, you can jump right in. Play to the rhythm, explore notes and chords, and create music at your own pace.

Designed for iOS (iPhone & iPad), Piano offers a smooth, responsive playing experience with intuitive touch controls, clean visuals, and a simple layout. Perfect for beginners, casual players, and anyone who wants to enjoy piano practice without pressure.

Discover piano through interactive gameplay, creative tools, and realistic instrument sounds.

Play classical piano favorites like Für Elise Clair de Lune and Moonlight Sonata
Learn timeless works like Canon in D Ode to Joy and The Entertainer
Discover expressive piano pieces like Gymnopédie No 1 and Nocturne
Enjoy traditional songs like The Star Spangled Banner Amazing Grace and Yankee Doodle

Choose Your Mode 
- Rhythm Play: Interactive gameplay to build timing, coordination, and confidence.
- Freestyle Keyboard: A realistic instrument experience for practicing chords, melodies, and musical ideas.
Both modes are powerful practice tools, helping you focus on rhythm, control, and musical expression.


What You Can Do

Play to the rhythm
Follow timing cues, play step by step, and learn how songs come together.

Freestyle Keyboard
Use a full piano keyboard with real notes & chords, ideal for practicing, exploration, or composing your own melodies freely.

Responsive Touch Keys
Enjoy smooth, accurate playing with touch-sensitive keys built for a great iOS experience.

Create, Record & Share
Go beyond practicing; turn your ideas into real music. Record your performances, capture your progress, and share your journey with friends and a global community of players.

Multiple Instruments
Play grand piano, electric keys, xylophone, and more. A wide range of authentic sounds.

Progress as You Play
Unlock songs, earn rewards, and move from simple tunes to more advanced arrangements.

Explore Every Genre
Play classical masterpieces, pop hits, jazz, kids' songs, film themes, and more.
Enjoy music from Mozart, Beethoven, Chopin, Tchaikovsky, Vivaldi, Bach, Strauss, and Verdi, alongside modern favorites like Bella Ciao and Twinkle Twinkle.
Search, browse, and jump into any song you want to play.


Piano Pro
Upgrade to unlock the full experience:
• Unlimited songs to play
• Multiple instrument sounds
• Ad-free practice
• Record with perfect timing

Your subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before renewal.
Manage subscriptions in your App Store settings.

Terms & Privacy: https://impalastudios.com/terms | https://impalastudios.com/privacy 

Feedback & Support
We'd love to hear from you: support@impalastudios.com

Join a global community of millions of players who practice, create, and share music every day.
Piano is a go-to app for learning, playing, and performing music - trusted and loved worldwide.

About Impala Studios
Impala Studios creates popular apps designed to make everyday life more fun and enjoyable. From music and games to productivity tools, our apps are built for iPhone and iPad users around the world. With Piano, we bring millions of music lovers together to play, learn, and share songs every day.

Piano © 2016 Impala Studios

• Stem Creation: Break down songs into individual components.
• Mashup: Create amazing mashups from two songs with just one click!

Ready to transform your audio experience? Download Stemz now and start creating!

it.name: BandLab – Music Maker & Beats
it.d:
Feeling inspired on the go? Our free music-making app empowers you to turn ideas into release-ready tracks fast. Record vocals, make beats, or mix demos – everything you need is built into your mobile DAW. Easily connect and collaborate with like-minded creators on our social music platform! Plus, go further with BandLab Membership! Unlock exclusive creation features (with AI tools), fuel your growth with global Distribution & industry Opportunities, and stand out with platform perks.

Thanks to our community, we’re an App of the Year 2025 finalist! Join 100M+ creators pushing boundaries and explore our top music tools: 

► Make music with pro-grade virtual instruments & audio presets 
• 385+ VST Instruments: Explore a wide range of sounds from pianos and guitars to bagpipes
• 28 Members-only Instruments: Access premium instruments with adjustable parameters to shape your sound
• 300+ vocal/ guitar/ bass/ audio presets: Enhance your sound in a tap with ready-made FX presets
• Members-only FX: Add instant shine with premium FX like Vocal Verb & Visual EQ, or dial in full chain results in a twist with 8 One Knobs
• AI Fx Preset Generator (Members-only): Generate custom FX chains from simple text prompts 

► Create without limits with free tools like Sampler
• Drum Machine: Craft drum parts with an online sequencer pre-loaded with drum kits
• Sampler: Record custom sounds or browse 250K+ royalty-free BandLab Sounds samples 
• Looper: Trigger pre-made loop packs as a starting point for building beats
• Free BandLab Beats: License 1 free beat/week with a basic plan or claim 10 free as a Member

► Generate song ideas with SongStarter
• Get unlimited, royalty-free ideas from this AI music generator
• Regenerate 3 unique compositions at a time until you land on one you like

► Auto-tune your vocals with AutoPitch
• Choose the key & scale of your song, and auto-tune your vocals with 6 free effects 
• Adjust the dial for easy, natural-sounding pitch correction

Members-only:
• Explore 18 bonus AutoPitch Fx spanning hip-hop to hyperpop
• Use advanced settings like Harmony Mix controls, 3 recording algorithms, & Custom Scales

► Practice vocal drills with VoiceTrainer 
•  Level up your singing skills with guided warmups, breathing routines, and vocal exercises tailored to you

► Remove vocals or instruments with Splitter 
• Split your song into vocals, drums, bass, & others with our free stem separation tool 
• Extract high-quality stems for karaoke versions & remixes

Members-only:
• Isolate lead & backing vocals
• Extract individual drum stems 
• Extract up to 7 audio stems (guitar/piano/strings)
• Direct Studio access, MIDI conversion, & faster processing speeds

► Polish your sound with instant Mastering 
• Pick from 4 free presets designed by Grammy-winning engineers
• Master MP3/MP4/ WAV tracks optimized for streaming 

Members-only
• Get 4 bonus presets suited for more genres like jazz & orchestra
• Fine-tune your sound with precision using a 11-step intensity slider 

► Remove background noise from your recordings
• Tame sibilance with De-Esser or cut low-level background noise with Noise Gate for clearer takes
• Voice Cleaner (Members-only): Remove background noise from your vocals, apply EQ, & cut reverb instantly!

► Achieve instant mix clarity with AutoMix (Members-only)
• Auto-adjust volume & panning with this AI mixing tool
• Balance your mix in a tap for any genre, no experience needed

► Modify your voice with Voice Changer (Members-only)
• Explore 17 male & female AI voices
• Transform the tone, texture, or gender of your voice & hear live previews

Top BandLab features for music creators:
•  Free song cloud storage
•  Unlimited multi-track projects
•  Easy project syncing with a cross-device DAW
•  Pro-grade music production features with 8 AI tools
•  Easy export or sharing to social media & music DSPs

Terms of Use: https://blog.bandlab.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://blog.bandlab.com/privacy-policy/

it.name: Spotify: Music and Podcasts
it.d:
With the Spotify app, you can explore an extensive library of music and podcasts for free. Curate the best playlists and stream millions of free songs, albums, and original podcasts on your phone or tablet. Subscribe to Spotify Premium to download and listen offline wherever you are, and unlock our catalog of audiobooks.

Why choose Spotify as your go-to music and podcast app? Here, you can:
• Listen to over 100 million songs and 6 million podcast titles
• Explore our selection of specially-crafted artist playlists
• Easily search for your favorite songs, albums, artists, and podcasts
• Discover personalized music recommendations tailored to your unique taste
• Subscribe to your favorite free podcasts so you never miss an episode, and even curate your own podcast library

Spotify Free is more than a music player - find the sounds you love and stream music and podcasts online, for free. Enjoy personalized playlists or curate and share your own, discover the hottest new releases, explore upcoming events from your favorites, and more.

• Stream millions of free songs and podcasts
• Create playlists with your favorite music
• Share songs and playlists with friends and family (feature restrictions may apply in some regions)
• Discover personalized playlists made just for you, and collaborate on playlists with your friends
• Enjoy your personal Discover Weekly playlist every week
• Stay in the know with the Release Radar and New Music Friday playlists
• Find nearby events and gigs by your favorite artists
• See your most played songs, genres, artists, and more with yearly Spotify Wrapped
• Stream music across your devices with Spotify
• Use Spotify Connect and enjoy listening on smart speakers, desktop, laptop, smart TV, Chromecast, PlayStation®, Xbox®, smartwatch, in your car, and more - limited number of device models apply

Spotify Premium - a great way to enjoy the benefits of an offline music player, and stream music without WiFi. By pressing download, you can access your songs, playlists, podcasts, and audiobooks offline, wherever you are.
• Listen to music, podcasts, and audiobooks - all in one place
• Ad-free music listening: enjoy your music with no ad interruptions
• Enjoy full on-demand playback
• Audiobooks in Premium are currently available in the US, UK, Australia, Ireland, New Zealand, and Canada. Discover 250,000+ audiobook titles with 15 hours/month of available listening for Premium Individual subscribers and Duo & Family plan managers.
• Superior sound quality on supported devices
• AI DJ: a personalized guide that knows your music taste so well it can choose what to play for you
• Enjoy on desktop, phone, tablet, computer, smartwatch, and in your car
• Listen and control the listening session together by hosting a Jam in real time with friends
• Download songs, podcasts, and audiobooks for offline listening, without an internet connection
• No contract required - cancel your subscription whenever you want

Spotify lets you play music wherever you are. Listen to your favorite songs and discover new music, podcasts, and audiobooks with the Spotify app!

LOVE SPOTIFY?
Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/spotify
Follow us on TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@spotify

Switching music apps? Don't leave your playlists behind.

Free Your Music transfers your playlists, albums, and liked songs between all major streaming services. Move from Spotify to Apple Music, Apple Music to Spotify, YouTube Music to TIDAL — any direction, in minutes.

1. Connect your current and new music service
2. Pick the playlists and albums you want to move
3. We match every song and start the transfer
4. Review the results — see exactly what moved and fix anything that didn't

Your first 600 songs transfer completely free.

◉ Supported services:
Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, Amazon Music, TIDAL, SoundCloud, Deezer, Napster — and more coming.

◉ Key features:
• Transfer playlists, albums, and your liked-songs library
• Keep playlists in sync — new songs you add are copied automatically
• Accurate song matching with a full transfer report
• Move one playlist or your entire library in a single run
• Works on iPhone, iPad, and Mac — one purchase covers all your devices
• No copy-paste, no spreadsheets, no lost songs

◉ Thinking about TuneMyMusic, Soundiiz, or SongShift?
Free Your Music is the simple, reliable alternative: transfers run on your device, your library never sits on someone else's server, and you can start free.

Download Free Your Music and take your playlists with you. Your music belongs to you — keep it wherever you go.

it.name: SoundLab - Audio Editor
it.d:
Bringing desktop-grade audio editing, recording, and on-device AI together, SoundLab is a powerful sound editor that lets you edit audio, clean up speech, separate vocals, and mix up to 16 tracks.

SoundLab is more than an audio editor. It is built for the ideas, quick edits, and unexpected creative needs that come up during music and podcast production, so you can start creating anytime, anywhere on your iPhone or iPad.

We won't claim SoundLab replaces a desktop DAW. But it is a serious mobile production tool for the moment the idea arrives and you don't want to open a computer — or wait thirty seconds for a desktop DAW to launch.

Precise Multitrack Audio Editor
• Mix up to 16 tracks with gain, pan, mute, and reordering.
• Copy, cut, paste, trim, insert, replace, split, duplicate, join, move, and more—with unlimited undo/redo.
• Zoom smoothly for millisecond-level selections.
• Loop any range while you work.
• Draw non-destructive volume curves for fades and ducking.
• Record overdubs directly into your project while monitoring playback.

AI Vocal Separator & Vocal Remover
Separate vocals and instrumentals, create acapellas, or make backing tracks with the vocal remover. Karaoke Mode preserves fuller accompaniment. AI runs locally: no uploads or server queue.

AI Stem Separator
Split into four stems—vocals, drums, bass, other—or six with guitar and piano. Preview and balance parts, then export a mix or individual stems.

AI Noise Reducer & Audio Enhancer
Use AI Noise Reducer on recordings or AI Noise Suppression on selected audio. EQ, compression, de-essing, normalization, amplification, and Bass Boost provide enhancement for voice and music.

25+ Selection-Based Effects
Apply 25+ effects to any waveform range, including AI separation and noise suppression, 10-band EQ, Reverb Pro, Tape Delay, Compressor, Change Pitch/Tempo, Fade In/Out, Phaser, Reverse, Silence Remover, and more.

Master Effects
Master Effects run in real time on the mix bus. Adjust tempo, pitch, reverb, and EQ while previewing, then export alternate versions without changing tracks or clips.

Audio Recorder
• Quick Recorder: Capture ideas with your chosen input device.
• Recording Studio: Monitor your mic, set input gain, use a limiter and reverb, and record over a backing track—with or without it in the saved mix.
• Use compatible external microphones and audio interfaces recognized by iOS.

Import, Create & Organize
• Import from Files, Music Library, other apps, or Wi-Fi; extract audio from video.
• Convert text to speech and add, insert, or replace audio in your project.
• Sync audio with iCloud; archive and restore projects through iCloud, USB drives, or external storage.
• Use Video Composer to mix audio with video and create soundtrack videos.

Flexible Export
Export AAC, ALAC, MP3, FLAC, or WAV with selectable channels and sample rates, plus high-bitrate and lossless options. Add metadata and cover art in supported formats. Save to Files or iCloud, share, or export a ringtone.

SoundLab is perfect for:
• Music lovers and independent creators
• Podcast and voice-over producers
• Music students and teachers
• Especially for users who are familiar with Audacity or Audition

SoundLab Pro
SoundLab Pro unlocks all Pro features. Choose monthly or annual auto-renewing subscriptions or a one-time permanent purchase. All support Family Sharing with up to five other family members.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Free trials convert to paid subscriptions, and subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in App Store account settings.

Customer Support

it.name: Spotify: Music and Podcasts
it.d:
With the Spotify app, you can explore an extensive library of music and podcasts for free. Curate the best playlists and stream millions of free songs, albums, and original podcasts on your phone or tablet. Subscribe to Spotify Premium to download and listen offline wherever you are, and unlock our catalog of audiobooks.

Why choose Spotify as your go-to music and podcast app? Here, you can:
• Listen to over 100 million songs and 6 million podcast titles
• Explore our selection of specially-crafted artist playlists
• Easily search for your favorite songs, albums, artists, and podcasts
• Discover personalized music recommendations tailored to your unique taste
• Subscribe to your favorite free podcasts so you never miss an episode, and even curate your own podcast library

Spotify Free is more than a music player - find the sounds you love and stream music and podcasts online, for free. Enjoy personalized playlists or curate and share your own, discover the hottest new releases, explore upcoming events from your favorites, and more.

• Stream millions of free songs and podcasts
• Create playlists with your favorite music
• Share songs and playlists with friends and family (feature restrictions may apply in some regions)
• Discover personalized playlists made just for you, and collaborate on playlists with your friends
• Enjoy your personal Discover Weekly playlist every week
• Stay in the know with the Release Radar and New Music Friday playlists
• Find nearby events and gigs by your favorite artists
• See your most played songs, genres, artists, and more with yearly Spotify Wrapped
• Stream music across your devices with Spotify
• Use Spotify Connect and enjoy listening on smart speakers, desktop, laptop, smart TV, Chromecast, PlayStation®, Xbox®, smartwatch, in your car, and more - limited number of device models apply

Spotify Premium - a great way to enjoy the benefits of an offline music player, and stream music without WiFi. By pressing download, you can access your songs, playlists, podcasts, and audiobooks offline, wherever you are.
• Listen to music, podcasts, and audiobooks - all in one place
• Ad-free music listening: enjoy your music with no ad interruptions
• Enjoy full on-demand playback
• Audiobooks in Premium are currently available in the US, UK, Australia, Ireland, New Zealand, and Canada. Discover 250,000+ audiobook titles with 15 hours/month of available listening for Premium Individual subscribers and Duo & Family plan managers.
• Superior sound quality on supported devices
• AI DJ: a personalized guide that knows your music taste so well it can choose what to play for you
• Enjoy on desktop, phone, tablet, computer, smartwatch, and in your car
• Listen and control the listening session together by hosting a Jam in real time with friends
• Download songs, podcasts, and audiobooks for offline listening, without an internet connection
• No contract required - cancel your subscription whenever you want

Spotify lets you play music wherever you are. Listen to your favorite songs and discover new music, podcasts, and audiobooks with the Spotify app!

Want to make beats, but music software feels like rocket science?
Learn to create killer tracks with an addictive music game.
No theory, no complex menus. This beat maker turns learning into a challenge you can't put down. Just tap and play your first song.

This isn't just a game. It's a music creator designed to teach you real skills. Our lessons, developed by pro producers, break down complex rhythms into simple, fun challenges. You'll build real finger drumming muscle memory with every tap, turning your phone into a powerful drum pad machine.

LEARN WITH A RHYTHM GAME
Tired of boring tutorials? Our addictive, game-like lessons teach you timing and rhythm by having you play along to hit tracks. This is the most fun way to learn to make beats.

PRO BEAT MAKER LESSONS
Go from beginner to pro with over 1,000 lessons. Master every genre, from a trap beat maker to an EDM song maker, with step-by-step guidance from experienced artists.

INTUITIVE DRUM PAD MACHINE
Forget tiny buttons and confusing interfaces. Our drum pads are designed for creative finger drumming, making it easy to lay down rhythms, basslines, and melodies on one screen.

CAREER MODE CHALLENGE
Put your skills to the test in an action-packed career mode. Progress through levels, unlock new sound packs, and rise from the bedroom studio to the main stage. This is the challenge game for aspiring music creators.

VAST SOUND LIBRARY
Your beats will sound polished from day one. Get access to hundreds of pro-quality sound packs and samples, with new kits for EDM, Trap, House, and Pop added every week.

EASY SONG MAKER
Don't just make loops—create full songs. Our simple studio view lets you arrange your patterns, add effects, and build a complete track from start to finish, all inside the app.

Join millions of players who learned to make music with our addictive beat making app. Rated 4.7/5 for making music creation fun and easy.

Stop dreaming about making music and start playing. Download now and create your first beat in the next 5 minutes.

it.name: Evermusic: Cloud Music Player
it.d:
Evermusic – Cloud & Offline Music Player for iPhone and iPad.

Stream your entire music library from the cloud, listen offline, and take full control of your sound. Evermusic combines a powerful audio player, equalizer, playlist manager, and file organizer in one beautiful app.

• Play All Audio Formats
Evermusic supports the most popular audio formats: MP3, AAC, M4A, WAV, AIFF, ALAC, M4B, and many others.

• Connect Your Cloud
Create your own music streaming service by moving your music library to the cloud. Listen to your music directly from the cloud, freeing up space on your iPhone for photos and new apps. Access music from most popular cloud services like iCloud, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, pCloud, and many others. Access privacy-focused cloud services like MEGA, Internxt, and Proton Drive as well.

• Connect Media Servers
Connect Plex, Subsonic, Navidrome, Jellyfin, and Emby media servers with your library easily.

• Connect Your Computer or NAS
Connect using SMB, WebDAV, DLNA, FTP, SFTP, and NFS protocols. Advanced buffering technologies ensure smooth playback. Connect to personal NAS storage using native APIs for QNAP, WD My Cloud Home, Nextcloud, and Synology Drive. Import audio files from your computer using iTunes File Sharing and Wi-Fi file transfer.

• Offline Music
Download your favorite songs, albums, and artists to listen offline. Enable the audio player cache to automatically download recently played songs.

• Audio Equalizer
The built-in equalizer offers presets for popular music genres, plus manual settings to customize your sound and amplify your music.

• Gapless Playback
Enjoy smooth playback with no pauses between songs, perfect for conceptual albums and classical music.

• Crossfade Playback
Enjoy continuous playback with the crossfade feature, where the next song starts before the current one ends.

• Audio Effects
Make your music sound the way you like with built-in audio effects. Turn on volume normalization to keep every track at the same loudness, and adjust playback with reverb, delay, distortion, and spatial audio.

• Music Visualizer
Watch full-screen animated visuals that react live to your music. Choose from a large library of presets, or let them cycle.

• Lyrics and Comments
View embedded timed lyrics and comments for your audio tracks. Activate the lyrics widget on the Home Screen for quick access.

• AirPlay & Chromecast
Stream music to Apple TV, smart speakers, or other devices with AirPlay or Chromecast.

• Apple CarPlay
Drive and listen safely with an interface made for CarPlay.

• Widgets
Activate interactive Home Screen widgets for fast access to your playback queue and continue playback from the last saved position.

• Audiobooks
Use this app as an audiobook player with features like audio bookmarks, playback speed control, and media position saving. Read text information in your songs' metadata.

• Automatic Synchronization
Your music library automatically syncs between the cloud and your device, grouping songs by artist, album, and genre.

• Playlists Manager
Create and manage playlists, reorder songs, and make playlists available offline. Sort songs by name, size, song number, and album.

• ID3 Tags Editor
Edit audio tags to correct any corrupted metadata in your files.

• File Manager
Manage your files with basic operations using the integrated file manager.

• Advanced Search
The smart search engine helps you find your favorite albums, artists, and songs in your music library.

• USB Flash Cards
Connect external card readers like the SanDisk iXpand and listen to music directly from your SD card.

----------

Evermusic is your all-in-one music player, cloud streamer, downloader, and file manager for iPhone and iPad. Great for music lovers, bands, producers, audiophiles, students, and audiobook listeners.

Privacy Policy: https://www.everappz.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.everappz.com/terms-and-conditions

it.name: Spotify: Music and Podcasts
it.d:
With the Spotify app, you can explore an extensive library of music and podcasts for free. Curate the best playlists and stream millions of free songs, albums, and original podcasts on your phone or tablet. Subscribe to Spotify Premium to download and listen offline wherever you are, and unlock our catalog of audiobooks.

Why choose Spotify as your go-to music and podcast app? Here, you can:
• Listen to over 100 million songs and 6 million podcast titles
• Explore our selection of specially-crafted artist playlists
• Easily search for your favorite songs, albums, artists, and podcasts
• Discover personalized music recommendations tailored to your unique taste
• Subscribe to your favorite free podcasts so you never miss an episode, and even curate your own podcast library

Spotify Free is more than a music player - find the sounds you love and stream music and podcasts online, for free. Enjoy personalized playlists or curate and share your own, discover the hottest new releases, explore upcoming events from your favorites, and more.

• Stream millions of free songs and podcasts
• Create playlists with your favorite music
• Share songs and playlists with friends and family (feature restrictions may apply in some regions)
• Discover personalized playlists made just for you, and collaborate on playlists with your friends
• Enjoy your personal Discover Weekly playlist every week
• Stay in the know with the Release Radar and New Music Friday playlists
• Find nearby events and gigs by your favorite artists
• See your most played songs, genres, artists, and more with yearly Spotify Wrapped
• Stream music across your devices with Spotify
• Use Spotify Connect and enjoy listening on smart speakers, desktop, laptop, smart TV, Chromecast, PlayStation®, Xbox®, smartwatch, in your car, and more - limited number of device models apply

Spotify Premium - a great way to enjoy the benefits of an offline music player, and stream music without WiFi. By pressing download, you can access your songs, playlists, podcasts, and audiobooks offline, wherever you are.
• Listen to music, podcasts, and audiobooks - all in one place
• Ad-free music listening: enjoy your music with no ad interruptions
• Enjoy full on-demand playback
• Audiobooks in Premium are currently available in the US, UK, Australia, Ireland, New Zealand, and Canada. Discover 250,000+ audiobook titles with 15 hours/month of available listening for Premium Individual subscribers and Duo & Family plan managers.
• Superior sound quality on supported devices
• AI DJ: a personalized guide that knows your music taste so well it can choose what to play for you
• Enjoy on desktop, phone, tablet, computer, smartwatch, and in your car
• Listen and control the listening session together by hosting a Jam in real time with friends
• Download songs, podcasts, and audiobooks for offline listening, without an internet connection
• No contract required - cancel your subscription whenever you want

Spotify lets you play music wherever you are. Listen to your favorite songs and discover new music, podcasts, and audiobooks with the Spotify app!

LOVE SPOTIFY?

it.name: TuneIn Radio: Music & Sports
it.d:
Listen to All the Audio You Love, All in One Place

Access over 100,000 live AM/FM radio stations from around the world, plus exclusive content from news, sports, music, podcasts, and audiobooks—all across your devices. Enjoy a broader range of audio than Pandora or iHeartRadio, all in one place.

Your Personalized Soundtrack

Tune in to your favorite live stations or explore 100,000+ AM/FM stations from 197+ countries. Whether you’re in the mood for Today’s Hits, Classic Rock, Smooth Jazz, or something else, TuneIn has you covered—offering more variety and control than platforms like Pandora or iHeartRadio. Discover legendary stations like 106.7 Lite FM, Power 105.1, 102.7 KIIS-FM, and more.

Apple Music Radio now on TuneIn

Apple Music Radio has landed. Stream Apple Music 1, Chill, Country, Club & Hits live on TuneIn. Catch your favorite artists like Billie Eilish, Ed Sheeran, The Weeknd, Frank Ocean and more.

Stay Informed with Trusted News

Get the latest headlines and live updates from top news sources like CNN, FOX News Radio, MS NOW, Bloomberg Radio, CNBC, NPR, and BBC. Access 24/7 news, including local, national, and global coverage. Stream news stations such as WNYC-FM, KQED-FM, and WTOP Washington DC, or stay informed with top podcasts like The Daily and Up First.

All Your Favorite Sports

From MLB and NFL to NHL and college sports, catch every game and never miss a play. With TuneIn, follow your team all season long with curated content and game-time notifications. Stream sports talk stations like ESPN Radio, talkSPORT, Fox Sports Radio, and local shows. Plus, enjoy on-demand sports podcasts like Undisputed, First Take, and The Bill Simmons Podcast.

Podcasts for Every Passion

Explore the world’s most popular podcasts, including Stuff You Should Know, Hidden Brain, Wow in the World, and more. Whether commuting, working out, or unwinding, TuneIn offers top global podcasts that you can stream on-demand.

Stream Everywhere, Anytime

Take TuneIn with you wherever you go. Listen on iOS, tablets, or connected devices. Control your audio experience with Amazon Alexa, Google Home, or in your car with CarPlay and compatible vehicles like Tesla, Mercedes, and Volvo.

Unlock Even More with TuneIn Premium

Upgrade to TuneIn Premium for ad-free content, exclusive features, and more:

Live Sports: Commercial-free coverage of NHL games, college sports, racing, and more—without blackouts.
Ad-Free News: Enjoy uninterrupted news coverage from CNBC, CNN, FOX News Radio, and more.
Unlimited Audiobooks: Access over 100,000 audiobooks with no extra cost or limitations.
Commercial-Free Music: Stream your favorite music stations non-stop with no ads.
Fewer Ads Across All Stations: Enjoy listening to 100,000+ stations with fewer interruptions than Pandora or iHeartRadio.

Subscribe to TuneIn Premium through the free app. If you choose to subscribe, you will be charged a monthly or annual subscription fee according to your country. The subscription fee will be shown in the app before you complete the payment. Your subscription will automatically renew every month or year at the then-current subscription fee unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the then-current subscription period. Your iTunes account will automatically be charged within 24 hours prior to the end of the then-current period. The subscription fee will be charged monthly or annually according to your subscription. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings.

Terms of use: http://tunein.com/policies

it.name: Flacbox: Hi-Res Music Player
it.d:
Flacbox is a Hi-Res music player for people who love great sound. Play almost any audio file on your iPhone or iPad in full lossless quality. Stream music from your NAS or cloud, and adjust the sound with a built-in equalizer.

Save space on your device by moving your music to a NAS or cloud. Stream it back, or save songs for offline listening. Your music library updates by itself and sorts songs by album, artist, genre, and composer. Make playlists, change the song order, and manage your files with the built-in file manager. Find any song fast with smart search.

The equalizer has genre presets, manual controls, and a tool to make the sound louder. You can save your own presets and share them.

SUPPORTED AUDIO FORMATS
- Lossless and Hi-Res: FLAC, ALAC, WAV, AIFF, DSF (DSD), PCM.
- Lossy: MP3, AAC, OGG, OPUS, AC3, WMA.
- Containers: M4A, M4V, MP4, MKV, MOV, MPEG.
- Tracker and MOD music: MOD, XM, IT, S3M.
- And more.

AUDIO EFFECTS
- Shape your sound in real time with reverb, delay, echo, chorus, flanger, phaser, and auto-wah.
- Add character with distortion, and control dynamics with a compressor.
- Crossfeed makes headphone listening more natural and less tiring.

DSP CHAIN
- Build your own signal chain from professional filters and tools.
- Filters: low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, and notch to shape or clean up the sound.
- EQ: peaking, low-shelf, and high-shelf for precise tone control.
- Level and drive: gain, soft-clip saturation, and a bit crusher for a lo-fi edge.
- Creative processors: tremolo, delay, ring modulator, and stereo width.

MUSIC VISUALIZER
- Watch full-screen animated visuals that react live to your music.
- Choose from a large library of presets, or let them cycle.

CLOUD AND PRIVATE STORAGE
- iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Box, MEGA, Yandex Disk, pCloud, HiDrive, OpenDrive, MediaFire, MyDrive, Put.io, InfiniCLOUD, WD MyCloud Home, Cloud Mail.ru, and Baidu Cloud.
- Private cloud services like MEGA, Internxt, and Proton Drive are also supported.

MEDIA SERVERS
- Connect Plex, Subsonic, Navidrome, Jellyfin, and Emby to open your full music library.

COMPUTER AND NAS CONNECTIONS
- Connect with SMB, WebDAV, DLNA, FTP, SFTP, and NFS.
- Connects directly to QNAP, WD My Cloud Home, Nextcloud, and Synology Drive.
- Smart buffering helps music play without breaks on slow networks.
- Add files from your computer with iTunes File Sharing or Wi-Fi transfer.

OFFLINE LISTENING
- Save songs, albums, or full artists to listen without internet.
- Turn on the audio cache to save recent songs without doing it by hand.

LYRICS AND COMMENTS
- See timed lyrics and song notes inside each track.
- Add the Lyrics widget to your Home Screen for quick access.

AIRPLAY AND CHROMECAST
- Send music to Apple TV, HomePod, smart speakers, and other devices with AirPlay, AirPlay 2, or Chromecast.

APPLE CARPLAY
- A simple CarPlay screen lets you choose music while you drive.

WIDGETS
- Home Screen widgets show your playback queue and let you start where you stopped.

PLAYBACK CONTROLS
- Adjust playback speed without changing the pitch.
- Save and restore your play queue and last position.
- Sleep timer and skip time controls.
- Shuffle and repeat modes, including stop after the current track.
- Plays in the background while you use other apps.

FILE MANAGER AND LIBRARY
- Sort your music by title, album, artist, album artist, genre, composer, rating, year, BPM, play count, bitrate, or length.
- Edit song tags with the built-in ID3 editor.
- Open files from external memory cards.
- Save playlists in M3U, M3U8, and CUE formats.

QUICK ACCESS
- Find your music in Recently Played, Favorites, and Bookmarks.

AUDIO QUALITY
- Sample rates from 8 kHz to 384 kHz.
- Audio output in default or mixed mode.
- Support for 1 to 7 audio channels.

Get Flacbox now and turn your iPhone into a real Hi-Res player.

Privacy Policy: https://www.everappz.com/privacy-policy
Terms and Conditions: https://www.everappz.com/terms-and-conditions

it.name: Evertag: Music Tag Editor
it.d:
Audio Tags Editor and Metadata Manager for iPhone and iPad

Take full control of your music library with Evertag — the powerful audio tag editor and metadata manager designed for music lovers, DJs, podcasters, and audiophiles. Edit ID3 tags, fix missing info, update album artwork, and organize your collection in just a few taps.

- SUPPORTED AUDIO FORMATS
Compatible with 30+ popular audio formats, including MP3, OGG, FLAC, OPUS, M4A, WMA, WAV, AIFF, APE, MOD, XM, S3M, IT, and many more.

- ADVANCED TAG EDITING
Modify 120+ audio tags such as Title, Artist, Album, Genre, Year, BPM, Track Number, Language, Mood, Publisher, Copyright, ISRC, Advisory Rating, and beyond — perfect for fine-tuning every detail of your music files.

- BATCH EDIT MODE
Update tags across multiple files at once. Save hours of work and keep your music collection perfectly organized.

- ALBUM COVERS AND ARTWORK
Easily find and add missing album covers. Make your music library look as great as it sounds across all your devices.

- AUTO TAG FINDER
Automatically detect and fill in missing metadata, or edit tags manually for full creative control.

- ENCODING FIX
Repair broken characters and encoding errors so every title and artist name displays correctly.

- CLOUD STORAGE INTEGRATION
Open and edit audio files directly from iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, and other cloud services — no downloads required.

- BUILT-IN FILE MANAGER
Browse, rename, move, and delete music files with ease. Mark your favorites and quickly access recently edited tracks.

- EXTERNAL FILE SUPPORT
Edit files stored in other apps or shared folders without copying them. Update tags and album covers instantly, right where the files live.

- WI-FI FILE TRANSFER
Send music wirelessly between your device and computer using any web browser. No cables, no extra apps.

- LIGHT AND DARK THEMES
Switch between light and dark modes to match your style or device settings.

----------

Evertag is the all-in-one audio tag editor, metadata manager, and music organizer for iPhone and iPad. Ideal for music collectors, audiobook listeners, DJs, producers, and anyone who wants a clean, well-organized library.

it.name: FL Studio Mobile
it.d:
Create and save complete multi-track music projects on your iPad, iPhone or Mac. Record, sequence, edit, mix and render complete songs.


FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS

* Audio recording, track-length stem/wav import
* Browse sample and presets with preview
* Effects modules (see Included Content)
* Full-screen MacBook and iMac Trackpad and Mouse support.
* High quality synthesizers, sampler, drum kits & sliced-loop beats
* Instrument modules (see Included Content)
* Load projects in the FL STUDIO** FREE Plugin version of this App
* MIDI controller support (class compliant). Automation support.
* MIDI file import and Export (Single-track or Multi-track)
* Mixer: Per-track mute, solo, effect bus, pan and volume adjustment
* Piano roll. Edit notes or capture recorded performances.
* Save and load WAV, MP3, AAC*, FLAC, MIDI
* Share your songs via Wi-Fi or Cloud to other Mobile 3 installations
* Step sequencer
* User interface configurable with all screen resolutions and sizes.
* Virtual piano-keyboard & Drumpads
* IAA App support (In/Out), Audiobus support (In/Out)
* Audio recording (external and internal sources)
* Share your songs via Sync to other Mobile 3 devices / installations
* Load your projects in the FL STUDIO* FREE 'Plugin' Version of this App#

IN APP PURCHASES & INCLUDED CONTENT


FL Studio Mobile includes in-app purchases for the DirectWave sample player. You can install your own samples and don’t need to buy content.


All Instrument modules are included: Drum Sampler, DirectWave Sample Player, GMS (Groove Machine Synth), Transistor Bass, MiniSynth & SuperSaw.

All Effect modules are included: Analyzer (visual), Auto Ducker, Auto-Pitch (pitch correction), Chorus, Compressor, Limiter, Distortion, Parametric Equalizer, Graphic Equalizer, Flanger, Reverb, Tuner (Guitar/Vocal/Inst), High-Pass/Low-Pass/Band-Pass/Formant (Vox) Filters, Delays, Phaser and Stereoizer.

Included Drum Samples: Cymbals, Hats, Kicks, Snares, Toms, Percussion, Risers, SFX

Included DirectWave Instruments: Guitars, Keyboards, Orchestral, Synth, Bass, Synth Keyboards, Synth Leads, Synth Pads, Sliced, Drums, Drum Kits and Effects.

Included MiniSynth Presets: Bass, Keys, Leads, Pads, SFX, Synths

Included SuperSaw Presets: Arps, Bass, Bells, SFX, Leads, Pads, Sequences, Synths

WANT TO TRY BEFORE YOU BUY?

Install FL STUDIO 20 for macOS / Windows and you can use the FL Studio Mobile Plugin. This is identical to the App, as a plugin inside FL Studio. Get it here: http://www.image-line.com/downloads/flstudiodownload.html

MANUAL / TRAINING / VIDEOS

http://support.image-line.com/redirect/flstudiomobile_help
http://support.image-line.com/redirect/flstudiomobile_videos




SUPPORT




Please help us to help you! In the App, tap 'Help > Users & Support Forums' to register FL Studio Mobile to your Image-Line account and gain access to the forum. You can then report bugs, make feature requests and access free downloadable content: http://support.image-line.com/redirect/flmobile_forum

it.name: djay - DJ App & AI Mixer
it.d:
*** Now with Spotify and Apple Music integration ***

Welcome to djay! The #1 DJ app and winner of multiple Apple Design Awards lets you start mixing your favorite music instantly. Connect your Spotify or Apple Music account to access millions of songs and create your own DJ mixes in no time – right inside djay.

djay transforms your iOS device into a full-featured DJ system. Seamlessly integrated with your music library, djay allows you to mix your favorite songs and playlists. You can perform live, remix tracks, or enable Automix mode to let djay create a seamless mix for you automatically. Whether you are a professional DJ or a beginner who just loves to play with music, djay offers you the most intuitive yet powerful DJ experience on an iOS device. 

SPOTIFY INTEGRATION

• Access to the full Spotify music catalog
• Your playlists, editorial selections, and more seamlessly integrated
• Powerful search capabilities for the vast music catalog of Spotify

APPLE MUSIC INTEGRATION

• Access to over 100 million songs
• Your library: all your music seamlessly integrated
• Powerful search capabilities for the vast music catalog of Apple Music
• Match: recommendations based on the currently playing song 
• Add songs and playlists to your Apple Music library right from within djay

ADVANCED MEDIA LIBRARY

• Spotify: Millions of tracks + your own playlists (Spotify Premium subscription)
• Apple Music: Millions of tracks + your personal library in the cloud (Apple Music subscription)
• TIDAL: Millions of tracks, music videos, high quality sound (TIDAL DJ Extension) 
• SoundCloud: Millions of underground and premium tracks (SoundCloud Go+) 
• Beatport: Millions of electronic music tracks (Beatport Advanced Subscriptions)
• Beatsource: Millions of open-format music tracks (Beatsource Subscription)
• Files: access files in the cloud (e.g. Dropbox), on your iOS device, or on external hard drives seamlessly
• My Collection: Powerful playlists management and meta data editing 

AUTOMIX

• Automatic, beat-matched mixes 
• Queue and Playlist automation

NEURAL MIX™

• Isolate vocals, drums, and instrumentals in real time (not available with Apple Music or Spotify)

MUSIC PRODUCTION TOOLS

• Sequencer: create beats on top of your music live
• Looper: remix your music with up to 48 loops per track
• Beat-matched sequencing of drums and samples
• Extensive content library with 1000+ loops and samples.

HARDWARE INTEGRATION

• Plug-and-play integration with 100+ MIDI controllers by Pioneer DJ, AlphaTheta, Reloop, Hercules, Numark, Denon DJ
• Digital Vinyl System (DVS) Integration
• Advanced MIDI Learn to map any class-compliant MIDI controller
• Support for Bluetooth audio and MIDI
• Support for multi-channel USB audio interfaces and video output

POWERFUL AUDIO ENGINE

• Ableton Link integration
• High-quality mixer, filter, EQ, isolator, and limiter
• Advanced time-stretching and pitch shifting
• Over 40 built-in audio effects 
• Live recording 

ADVANCED AUDIO ANALYSIS

• Fluid Beat Grid: the world’s most sophisticated beat detection and sync engine
• Key detection 
• Colored waveforms
• Auto-Gain 

BUILT FOR iOS

• Accessible via VoiceOver
• Airplay, Apple Watch, and iCloud integration

The optional PRO subscription allows you to subscribe once and use djay Pro across all your Mac and iOS devices, including access to all PRO features, as well as 1000+ loops, samples, and visuals. Cancel anytime. 

A supported streaming subscription and an internet connection are required to access songs from a streaming service in djay. No recording available for streamed songs. Neural Mix cannot be used when streaming from Apple Music or Spotify. Specific songs may not be available or accessible on your account or in your country. Streaming service availability and pricing may vary depending on country, currency and service.

• Lock Screen Lyrics & Dynamic Island Lyrics
Display real-time lyrics on the lock screen and Dynamic Island, enhancing your music experience.

• Lyrics Widget
Show real-time lyrics on the home screen widget and StandBy mode.

• Floating Lyrics
Display lyrics anywhere using a floating window.

• Supports Lyrics Translation
Translate lyrics into any supported language, breaking down language barriers.

• Supports Multiple Music Apps
Seamlessly compatible with Apple Music and Spotify for a smooth experience.

• Shazam Mode
With Shazam mode, you can identify music playing on any app, webpage, or in your surroundings and view the lyrics.

• Lyrics Sharing
Share beautiful lyrics cards effortlessly with friends.

Dynamic Lyrics® Membership Description:
By becoming a Dynamic Lyrics® member, you can unlock all premium features, enjoy free updates in the future, and benefit from an ad-free experience.
You can choose between a subscription or a lifetime membership with a one-time payment.
If you choose a subscription, it will automatically renew through your iTunes account.

To cancel the renewal, please manually turn off the auto-renewal option in your Apple ID settings at least 24 hours before the current subscription period ends.
If you do not cancel during the trial period, the subscription will automatically activate and charge you at the end of the trial.
This service is entirely optional. If you choose not to cancel, the next billing period will renew automatically.

it.name: Koala Sampler • Beat Maker
it.d:
Koala is the ultimate pocket-sized sampler. Record anything with your phone's mic or load your own sounds. Use Koala to create beats with those samples, add effects and create a track!

Koala's super intuitive interface helps you make a track in a flash - there is no brake pedal. You can also resample the output of the app back into the input, through the effects, so the sonic possibilities are endless.

Koala's design focuses totally on making the music-making process instant, keeping you in the flow and keeping it fun, not getting bogged down by pages of parameters and micro-editing.

"Been putting that $4 koala sampler to good use lately. Undeniably great tool that puts some of these expensive beat boxes to shame. A must cop."
-- flying lotus, twitter

* Record up to 64 different samples with your mic
* Transform your voice or any other sound with 16 superb built-in fx
* Load your own samples
* Choose from one of 250 built-in sounds
* Resample the output of the app back into a new sample
* Export loops or entire tracks as professional quality WAV files
* Direct export to Ableton Live Set
* Copy/paste or merge sequences just by dragging them
* Create beats with the high-resolution sequencer
* Import samples from the Files app or even from videos
* Keyboard mode lets you play chromatically or one of 9 scales
* Quantize, add swing to get the right feel
* Normal/One-shot/Loop/Reverse playback of samples
* 6 Choke groups
* Attack, release and tone adjustable on each sample
* Mute/Solo controls and note repeat
* Add any (or all) of the 16 effects to the entire mix
* AUv3 compatible - use in GarageBand, Logic, Cubasis etc etc
* MIDI controllable - play your samples on a keyboard, map the effects to knobs
* Jam with others over WiFi with Ableton Link
* Free copy of Ableton Live Lite included
* AudioShare compatible
* Use AI to separate samples into individual instruments (drums, bass, vocals and other)
* Set your own background image and choose from a growing list of background visual FX

8 Built-in Microphone FX:
* More Bass
* More Treble
* Fuzz
* Robot
* Reverb
* Octave up
* Octave down
* Synthesizer

16 Built-in DJ Mix FX:
* Bit-crusher
* Pitch-shift
* Comb filter
* Ring modulator
* Reverb
* Stutter
* Gate
* Resonant High/Low Pass Filters
* Cutter
* Reverse
* Dub
* Tempo Delay
* Talkbox
* VibroFlange
* Dirty
* Compressor

Features included in SAMURAI In-App Purchase
* Pro-quality Timestretch (5 modes: Modern, Retro, Beats, Re-pitch and Cyclic)
* Piano roll editor
* Auto-chop (auto, equal, and lazy chop)
* 3 Band EQ
* Pocket operator sync out
* Quokka Synth - powerhouse polyphonic synthesizer
* MIDI Out - control external MIDI hardware with Koala's sequencer
* Chopper - multimodal sample chopping instrument

Features included in MIXER In-App Purchase
* Mix your beats professionally with a 4 channel mixer + main bus
* Route any sample to any channel
* Mute/solo, faders and accurate metering on every channel
* 5 effect slots per channel
* 29 high-quality effects - compressors, filters, phasers and more, with new effects to come
* Host AUv3 plugins - both audio effects and instruments

With the Spotify app, you can explore an extensive library of music and podcasts for free. Curate the best playlists and stream millions of free songs, albums, and original podcasts on your phone or tablet. Subscribe to Spotify Premium to download and listen offline wherever you are, and unlock our catalog of audiobooks.

Why choose Spotify as your go-to music and podcast app? Here, you can:
• Listen to over 100 million songs and 6 million podcast titles
• Explore our selection of specially-crafted artist playlists
• Easily search for your favorite songs, albums, artists, and podcasts
• Discover personalized music recommendations tailored to your unique taste
• Subscribe to your favorite free podcasts so you never miss an episode, and even curate your own podcast library

Spotify Free is more than a music player - find the sounds you love and stream music and podcasts online, for free. Enjoy personalized playlists or curate and share your own, discover the hottest new releases, explore upcoming events from your favorites, and more.

• Stream millions of free songs and podcasts
• Create playlists with your favorite music
• Share songs and playlists with friends and family (feature restrictions may apply in some regions)
• Discover personalized playlists made just for you, and collaborate on playlists with your friends
• Enjoy your personal Discover Weekly playlist every week
• Stay in the know with the Release Radar and New Music Friday playlists
• Find nearby events and gigs by your favorite artists
• See your most played songs, genres, artists, and more with yearly Spotify Wrapped
• Stream music across your devices with Spotify
• Use Spotify Connect and enjoy listening on smart speakers, desktop, laptop, smart TV, Chromecast, PlayStation®, Xbox®, smartwatch, in your car, and more - limited number of device models apply

Spotify Premium - a great way to enjoy the benefits of an offline music player, and stream music without WiFi. By pressing download, you can access your songs, playlists, podcasts, and audiobooks offline, wherever you are.
• Listen to music, podcasts, and audiobooks - all in one place
• Ad-free music listening: enjoy your music with no ad interruptions

Melodia's next-gen AI song maker lets you write original tracks, craft viral covers, or transform your vocals, no studio, skills, or instruments required.
Choose from a wide range of styles and genres, including pop, rap, blues, funk, classical, EDM, R&B, lo-fi, rock, trap, acoustic, orchestral, and more.
Whatever your vibe, Melodia helps bring your musical vision to life with just a few taps.

Key Features:
Al Song Maker
Describe your idea, pick a genre and vocal style, and create an original song or cover from scratch with Melodia.

Al Cover Generator
Paste a song link, choose a voice, and recreate your favorite tracks with different vocals or genres to give any classic a fresh vibe.

Voice-to-Song Studio
Upload your vocals or recordings to train the AI, and customize pitch and tempo for fully personalized results.

Realistic, Natural-Sounding Vocals
Generate tracks with human-like vocals that add depth to your music.

Multi-Genre Support
Mix and match genres-pop, rap, rock, electronic, and more-to fit your creative vision.

Mood & Prompt Controls
Select moods like Happy, Confident, or Motivational, or type a custom prompt for lightning-fast results.

Melodia makes producing songs and covers easy. Every track you create is royalty-free and can be shared anywhere. Whether you're experimenting or polishing a final mix, the app gives you the tools to make music your way.

Perfect For:
﻿﻿Musicians prototyping hooks faster than ever
﻿﻿Creators who need copyright-safe background music
﻿﻿Singers looking for professional vocal effects
﻿﻿Anyone who wants to have fun making songs with Al
Note: Melodia Al doesn't supply songs or voices-you provide the source material. Use Melodia for entertainment and respect copyright rules when sharing. Some features require a Melodia Pro subscription.
Download Melodia - Al Song Maker today and start creating professional-quality music with Al.

it.name: Deezer: Music Player, Podcast
it.d:
Deezer is more than just a music platform.

It’s a fully personalized listening experience that adapts to you. Deezer is where you can embrace your tastes, turn up the volume, and Live the Music.

With a Deezer Premium plan, you'll get everything you need in one app:

Music you love, made for you
• A massive global catalog with all the tracks you could ever want
• Flow, your infinite, personalized mix of favorites and discoveries
• Smart recommendations that perfectly match your vibe
• Control your music discovery with simple, transparent algorithm controls
• Discover curated playlists for every mood, genre, or season
• Explore Audiobooks*, Radios*, and our growing Podcast catalog, with personalized picks based on your listening

Fun and interactive features
• Deezer Club gives you the chance to win tickets to attend exclusive live events
• Shaker lets you mix playlists with friends and compare your tastes
• Music Quiz tests your music knowledge, play solo or with friends
• SongCatcher helps you find any song playing around you

Customization at your fingertips
• Coming from another music app? Quickly bring all your music to Deezer with Transfer My Music
• Shape your algorithm to find more of the music you love
• Create playlists for every mood, genre, or moment and customize the covers
• Reorganize your Homepage and Library to put your top picks front and center
• Share any song or playlist, even with people who don't use Deezer
• Dive deeper with on-screen Lyrics and translations

And of course, the essentials
• Ad-free listening
• Offline mode lets you download your favorite albums, playlists, and podcasts for when you're low on service
• Unlimited skips and on-demand listening
• Enjoy HiFi sound for lossless listening that's built for audiophiles

Choose your plan:
• Deezer Premium – One Premium account with all our features
• Deezer Duo – Two Premium accounts, one subscription
• Deezer Family – Up to 6 Premium accounts with kid-friendly profiles
• Deezer Student – Get all the benefits of Deezer Premium for half the price
• Deezer Free* - Full access to our catalog, with occasional ads and limited features

Take Deezer anywhere
Connect your music to all your favorite devices, at home and on the go:
• Smart speakers like Alexa, HomePod Mini & Sonos for an easy smart home music setup
• On your wrist — Launch the Deezer app on your Apple Watch, Fitbit, or any Wear OS device and listen to your favorite tracks wherever you go
• In your car with Automotive OS for a powerful in-car audio player

Follow us:
Instagram: instagram.com/deezer
Facebook: facebook.com/deezer
X: x.com/deezer


Privacy policy
Terms of use
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/


*Some features and plans may not be available in all countries.

it.name: Superfan: social music
it.d:
I started Superfan because music didn’t feel personal anymore.

Streaming made everything available. But it made me feel distant from the artists I love and the friends I used to share music with.

So I built a home for my music life: stats, concerts, vinyl and friends.

Join 500,000 fans using Superfan to track their music lives and show up for the moments that matter.

SHARE YOUR MUSIC
- automatically track what you listen to from Spotify and Apple Music
- react, comment, and start conversations around what your friends are hearing
- discover new artists through people you actually trust

because algorithms shouldn't decide what you love.

GET YOUR WEEKLY RECAP
- your top artists, albums, and songs from the past week
- a weekly vibe that captures your listening identity
- see your friends' recaps and comment on them

because your listening history tells a story.

FOLLOW THE ARTISTS YOU LOVE
- see your full history with them over time
- understand your place in their fanbase
- show up for releases, tours, and the moments that matter

because supporting artists should feel real.

TRACK YOUR CONCERTS
- log every show and festival you attend
- tag your friends and upload photos from the night
- get reminded about your memories every year on the anniversary

because concerts shouldn't disappear into your camera roll.

LOG YOUR VINYL COLLECTION
- catalogue your vinyl, CDs, and cassettes
- tag friends when you play something
- see what your friends are spinning

because physical music matters more than ever.

SOUNDTRACK OF THE WEEK
- choose one song that defines your week
- see what defined your friends'
- build a timeline of your life, told through music

because everyone's life has a score.

GROUPS WITH FRIENDS
- create private groups with the people you listen with
- earn awards for top listener, saddest songs, and more

because music is better together.

Streaming made music endless.
Superfan makes it meaningful again.

---

Privacy Policy: https://superfan.social/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://superfan.social/terms-of-use
Feedback & Support: support@superfan.social

it.name: Cubasis 3 - DAW & Music Studio
it.d:
Quickly and easily capture your musical ideas as soon as they arrive and turn them into professional-sounding songs with the multi-award winning Cubasis 3. Enjoy performing, recording, mixing and sharing your music in no time, wherever you are, right there on your iPhone and iPad. Meet one of the fastest, most intuitive and complete audio and MIDI DAWs available on iOS today: Cubasis 3.

Computer Music Editor’s Choice Award 2020・MusicTech Choice Award 2020・NAMM TEC Awards 2026 Finalist
 
"Cubasis 3 marks a great leap to the iPhone, and maintains Cubasis’ status as the DAW to beat on the iOS platform." — Computer Music
 
"Cubasis has always represented the best balance between features and usability in any iOS DAW/sequencer, and in Cubasis 3, Steinberg have raised a high bar even higher." — Sound On Sound
 
"Cubasis 3 is far and away the most powerful and user-friendly mobile DAW around." — ASK Audio
 
"Cubasis has been invaluable for me when I just need to create a quick demo before the plane lands." — Rob Swire (Pendulum, Knife Party, Deadmau5)
 
Learn more about Cubasis at www.steinberg.net/cubasis
 
NEW IN CUBASIS 3
• Universal app support: Run Cubasis on the iPhone and iPad
• Tempo and signature track support
• Group tracks: Easily combine individual tracks to groups
• Full-screen mixer: Easily extend the size of the mixer and more
• New look, same feel: Enjoy creating more efficiently
• Free Cubasis 2 IAP transfer: Freely transfer previous in-app purchases to Cubasis 3
• 960 PPQN MIDI resolution: Precise audio and MIDI event editing at the highest level
• 8 insert, 8 send effects: Create great-sounding tracks with flexible effects options
• FX rearrangement: Quickly rearrange plug-ins and change their pre/post fader position
• 75 new effects presets: Make tracks sound great with these ready-to-use presets
• Undo with history list: Quickly jump back to earlier versions of your song
• Redesigned instruments and effects: Modern styling with more precise operation
• Audio, MIDI and automation editors revisited: File editing is much more effective
• Revised MediaBay: Your all-new control center for file and project management
• UI scale presets for iPhone and iPad: Quickly change the size and arrangement of Cubasis
• MicroSonic instruments refill: Get creative with great-sounding new instruments
 
HIGHLIGHTS
• Unlimited number of audio and MIDI tracks
• 24 assignable physical inputs and outputs
• 32-bit floating-point audio engine
• Audio I/O resolution of up to 24-bit/96 kHz
• Real-time time-stretching and pitch-shifting featuring zplane’s élastique 3
• Micrologue virtual analog synthesizer with 126 ready-to-go presets
• MicroSonic with over 120 virtual instrument sounds
• MiniSampler to create your own instruments (includes 20 factory instruments)
• Mixer with studio-grade channel strip per track and 17 effects processors
• Sidechain support
• Fully automatable DJ-like Spin FX effect plug-in
• Over 550 MIDI and time-stretch-capable audio loops
• Virtual keyboard with chord buttons, chord and drum pads with intuitive note repeat
• Audio editor and MIDI editor with MIDI CC support
• MIDI editor for programming and editing MIDI tracks quickly and efficiently
• MIDI Learn, Mackie Control (MCU) and HUI protocol support
• MIDI auto quantize and time-stretch
• Track duplicate
• Automation, MIDI CC, program change and aftertouch support
• Core Audio and MIDI-compatible hardware supported
• Keyboard shortcut and mouse support
• MIDI over Bluetooth LE support
• Audio Unit including Instrument Multi Out support, Inter-App Audio and Audiobus 3 support
• Ableton Link Support
• Import audio via iTunes, iCloud Drive, Files app, AirDrop or use AudioPaste
• MIDI clock and MIDI thru support
• Export to Cubase, iCloud Drive, external hard drives, wireless flash drives, Dropbox, AudioCopy and email
 
Technical support
http://www.steinberg.net/cubasisforum

If you like Cubasis, please support us by rating this app in the App Store! Thank you!

it.name: Flacbox: Hi-Res Music Player
it.d:
Flacbox is a Hi-Res music player for people who love great sound. Play almost any audio file on your iPhone or iPad in full lossless quality. Stream music from your NAS or cloud, and adjust the sound with a built-in equalizer.

Save space on your device by moving your music to a NAS or cloud. Stream it back, or save songs for offline listening. Your music library updates by itself and sorts songs by album, artist, genre, and composer. Make playlists, change the song order, and manage your files with the built-in file manager. Find any song fast with smart search.

The equalizer has genre presets, manual controls, and a tool to make the sound louder. You can save your own presets and share them.

SUPPORTED AUDIO FORMATS
- Lossless and Hi-Res: FLAC, ALAC, WAV, AIFF, DSF (DSD), PCM.
- Lossy: MP3, AAC, OGG, OPUS, AC3, WMA.
- Containers: M4A, M4V, MP4, MKV, MOV, MPEG.
- Tracker and MOD music: MOD, XM, IT, S3M.
- And more.

AUDIO EFFECTS
- Shape your sound in real time with reverb, delay, echo, chorus, flanger, phaser, and auto-wah.
- Add character with distortion, and control dynamics with a compressor.
- Crossfeed makes headphone listening more natural and less tiring.

DSP CHAIN
- Build your own signal chain from professional filters and tools.
- Filters: low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, and notch to shape or clean up the sound.
- EQ: peaking, low-shelf, and high-shelf for precise tone control.
- Level and drive: gain, soft-clip saturation, and a bit crusher for a lo-fi edge.
- Creative processors: tremolo, delay, ring modulator, and stereo width.

MUSIC VISUALIZER
- Watch full-screen animated visuals that react live to your music.
- Choose from a large library of presets, or let them cycle.

CLOUD AND PRIVATE STORAGE
- iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Box, MEGA, Yandex Disk, pCloud, HiDrive, OpenDrive, MediaFire, MyDrive, Put.io, InfiniCLOUD, WD MyCloud Home, Cloud Mail.ru, and Baidu Cloud.
- Private cloud services like MEGA, Internxt, and Proton Drive are also supported.

MEDIA SERVERS
- Connect Plex, Subsonic, Navidrome, Jellyfin, and Emby to open your full music library.

COMPUTER AND NAS CONNECTIONS
- Connect with SMB, WebDAV, DLNA, FTP, SFTP, and NFS.
- Connects directly to QNAP, WD My Cloud Home, Nextcloud, and Synology Drive.
- Smart buffering helps music play without breaks on slow networks.
- Add files from your computer with iTunes File Sharing or Wi-Fi transfer.

OFFLINE LISTENING
- Save songs, albums, or full artists to listen without internet.
- Turn on the audio cache to save recent songs without doing it by hand.

LYRICS AND COMMENTS
- See timed lyrics and song notes inside each track.
- Add the Lyrics widget to your Home Screen for quick access.

AIRPLAY AND CHROMECAST
- Send music to Apple TV, HomePod, smart speakers, and other devices with AirPlay, AirPlay 2, or Chromecast.

APPLE CARPLAY
- A simple CarPlay screen lets you choose music while you drive.

WIDGETS
- Home Screen widgets show your playback queue and let you start where you stopped.

PLAYBACK CONTROLS
- Adjust playback speed without changing the pitch.
- Save and restore your play queue and last position.
- Sleep timer and skip time controls.
- Shuffle and repeat modes, including stop after the current track.
- Plays in the background while you use other apps.

FILE MANAGER AND LIBRARY
- Sort your music by title, album, artist, album artist, genre, composer, rating, year, BPM, play count, bitrate, or length.
- Edit song tags with the built-in ID3 editor.
- Open files from external memory cards.
- Save playlists in M3U, M3U8, and CUE formats.

QUICK ACCESS
- Find your music in Recently Played, Favorites, and Bookmarks.

AUDIO QUALITY
- Sample rates from 8 kHz to 384 kHz.
- Audio output in default or mixed mode.
- Support for 1 to 7 audio channels.

Get Flacbox now and turn your iPhone into a real Hi-Res player.

PlayTally is the ultimate music companion that takes your listening experience to the next level.

REAL-TIME REPLAY
Now you have the power to relive your favorite songs anytime, not just on a yearly basis. PlayTally generates lists in real-time, ensuring you're always up to date with your music trends. Choose any date range and discover your top tracks for that specific period. Plus, you can easily mark tracks like white noise and sleep sounds to keep them out of your Trends list.

TRACK YOUR HISTORY
Track your music history effortlessly by syncing PlayTally data across multiple devices through iCloud Music Library. you can even track additional Apple Music devices. Take a trip down memory lane and see what you were jamming to on any given day. Plus, create personalized playlists from your music history.

EARN AWARDS
As you dive deeper into your music journey, PlayTally rewards you with badges for your dedication and growing music collection. It's like earning activity awards for your ears!

SEE YOUR STATS
Explore your music collection like never before with PlayTally's advanced statistics and charts. Easily sort and browse through large libraries based on your listening habits. Gain valuable insights into your music preferences over time and share your most impressive stats with friends and followers.

COMPLETELY AD-FREE.
No distractions, no interruptions. PlayTally is completely ad-free and seamlessly integrates with your Apple Music. No extra accounts, signups, or subscriptions required.

PRIVACY FIRST
Your privacy is our priority – your data stays on your device and personal iCloud storage, and you have the option to delete it whenever you want. If you wish, you can also export and backup your data in CSV format. You're in control.

NO VIBE-CODING
PlayTally is developed by an independent developer. No AI has been used in it's development.

—

TIPS FOR BEST PERFORMANCE
For optimal performance, make sure PlayTally regularly scans your music library. Create a convenient automated shortcut to open PlayTally daily or weekly, ensuring your data is always up to date and accurate.

NOTE: Because PlayTally tracks its own data, it cannot reconstruct playback history from before it was installed.

it.name: Smule: Sing, Duet & Record
it.d:
Sing, duet, and create music on Smule, a creative singing platform built to help you grow your voice with confidence. Join others in duets for free, or unlock solo recording when you are ready to practice, learn, and craft your sound.

Explore 15 million+ songs across pop, rock, R&B, country, K-pop, musicals, and more. Smule gives you the space to practice, improve, and explore your voice at your own pace, whether you are singing for fun or working toward becoming a better singer.

On Smule, you can begin by joining existing duets with singers from around the world at no cost. Singing together is a low pressure way to start, helping you learn by doing while building confidence through shared performances. With a VIP subscription, you can unlock solo recording and start your own duets or group songs, giving you more control to practice independently, refine performances, and shape your sound.

Smule offers one of the largest karaoke song libraries available, with new songs added regularly. You can also sing recorded duets alongside official tracks from global superstars. Smule lets you join pre recorded duet performances featuring artists like Ed Sheeran, Dua Lipa, Olivia Rodrigo, and Disney favorites, so you can learn songs you love and feel part of the music.

As you sing, Smule helps you improve naturally over time. You can practice with pitch guidance, adjust song keys to better fit your vocal range, and experiment with harmonies, layers, and arrangements. Whether you are practicing solo, joining duets, or creating group songs, Smule supports progress at every stage of your singing journey.

Smule uses studio quality audio and voice effects to support creativity without replacing your unique sound. You can enhance recordings with reverb, filters, and vocal effects, explore optional AI powered tools to refine tone and range, and experiment freely while keeping your voice authentic. These tools are designed to help you learn, improve, and gain confidence as you sing.

Smule is a global community of singers in more than 190 countries. You can join duets, create group songs, discover new artists and styles, participate in live singing sessions, or share performances when you feel ready. Many singers start by practicing and joining duets, then gradually unlock more creative options as their confidence grows.

Smule is built for every kind of singer, from curious first timers and casual karaoke fans to aspiring artists developing their voice. There is no single right way to use Smule. You choose how you practice, how you perform, and how far you want to go.

Smule is more than a karaoke app. It is a creative platform for learning to sing, practicing with purpose, building confidence, and growing through solo recordings, duets, and musical collaboration, powered by smart tools and a supportive global community. Download Smule and start singing today.

Subscription Info
Get unlimited access to Smule’s full karaoke song catalog and sing karaoke solos, duets, groups, or acapella. Subscriptions are available weekly, monthly, or yearly. Payment is charged to your iTunes Account at purchase and renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or turn off auto-renew in your Account Settings. Subscriptions cannot be canceled during the active period. Unused trial time is forfeited when a subscription starts.

it.name: Spectra - Music Visualizer
it.d:
Enjoy music at a deeper level with realtime visualization! Spectra is a lightweight music & audio visualizer app that allows you to select and visualize audio in realtime, right on your phone or mac. Want to export your visualization? We have you covered. Simply click the "Create Video" button from within the app. No longer do you need expensive software to create those beautiful animations you've seen on the internet. Want to customize the background image or put a logo in the center? We made that available as well. In fact, you can customize just about all aspects of the visualizer. You can even import audio files from apps like iMessage or Mail using the share sheet. We want to keep improving the app so If you have any suggestions, be sure to leave a review and tell us what feature you're missing!

The features:
• Amazing, 60fps realtime visualization for any audio file or iTunes music (not Apple Music) song
• Video exporting of your audio visualization (4k at 60fps)
• Custom background image
• Background presets
• Background effects
• Custom logo image
• Visualizer customization
• Particle customization
• Video export settings
• Video animation options
• Presets
• More to come!!!

Here's how it works:
The sound we hear is made up of many frequencies. The visualizer decomposes the audio input into its frequencies and displays the lower frequencies at the top/left of the audio spectrum and the higher frequencies at the bottom/right of the spectrum. This can create some cool-looking shapes that all correspond to the currently-playing audio track!

Whether you're a producer that wants to see the frequency range of their song, an audiophile, or someone who wants to take a deeper look into their music, this app is definitely for you.

Who is Voloco for?

Record Studio-Quality Vocals Anywhere

Voloco is a mobile vocal studio and audio editor that lets you record, tune, and polish your voice with professional results. Automatically remove background noise, correct pitch in real time, and apply high-quality effects so your recordings sound like they were made in a real studio.

Easy Vocal Recording & Editing

• Record vocals (or video) with real-time effects
• Separate vocals from existing songs or videos

Perfect for Content Creators

With over 70 million downloads, Voloco is one of the most popular singing and recording apps in the world. Whether you're making your first demo or finishing a full track, Voloco gives you pro-level tools in a simple mobile app.

Download Voloco today and start creating studio-quality vocals from your phone.

it.name: Amen Break Generator (Revived)
it.d:
Amen break - coming from the late 60's is one of the most famous drum loops sampled and remixed in hundreds of jungle, drum'n'bass and hiphop records. This six-second clip spawned several entire subcultures and gained massive fame among DJ's, producers and music fans.

We bring you the Amen Break Generator - a vintage-looking loop player designed for a real-time generating of infinite combinations of this famous break! You can remix the loop with your fingers, use looper and nonstop beat randomising algorithm and add various DSP effects.


FEATURES:

• Audio Unit v3 Support: Includes MIDI capabilities such as transport messages, slice triggering and loop selection using MIDI notes and running multiple instances 
• 16 Manual Trigger Buttons: Tempo-synced triggering of breaks for dynamic and creative control.
• Live Remixing Effects: Instantly apply effects like Freeze, Step Randomization, Auto-Retrigger, and more to remix breaks in real-time.
• Free-Play Mode: Manually trigger beat slices even when playback is stopped.
• Built-in Looper: A powerful tool that repeats the last 16 steps of the played sequence, enabling seamless looping and overdubbing for effortless creativity.
• Vintage-Inspired Graphics: Bitmaps in steam-punk style that enhance your experience.
• 4 DSP Effects: Includes Ring Modulator, Stereo Hi-Pass Filter, Flanger, and Degrader for diverse sound manipulation.
• Live WAV Recording: Capture your performance in high-quality WAV format, accessible directly in the iPhone’s Files app.
• Custom Loop Import: Load up to 8 custom loops in WAV format.
• 7 additional classic drum loops included for even more creative fun!
